title: desktop mode for color picker
line: A Color Picker widget made big enough on the desktop now shows the saved colors with a pick button, instead of one huge pick icon.
explanation: The Color Picker set preferredRepresentation to its compact representation unconditionally, so on the desktop it was always the pick button plus color circles, just scaled up when the widget was resized; the history grid only existed in the popup. The change replaces that with switchWidth/switchHeight of 10 grid units: below that the widget is the same compact buttons (default desktop size, panels, system tray), above it the history grid is shown inline with a heading that has a Pick Color button. The popup keeps its fixed 18-unit square size.

commits.message:
applets/colorpicker: show the color history when big enough on the desktop

The widget always used its compact representation, so on the desktop it
only showed the pick button and color circles however large it was. Now
a big enough widget shows the history grid with a pick button on top.

BUG: 360356

patches.diff:
From 9c103668c088ac9f60403555b367e7eb34ac019c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 23:13:14 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/colorpicker: show the color history when big enough
 on the desktop

The widget always used its compact representation, so on the desktop it
only showed the pick button and color circles however large it was. Now
a big enough widget shows the history grid with a pick button on top.

BUG: 360356
---
 applets/colorpicker/qml/main.qml | 53 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++-----
 1 file changed, 46 insertions(+), 7 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/colorpicker/qml/main.qml b/applets/colorpicker/qml/main.qml
index d07479f3d..8df6f52c1 100644
--- a/applets/colorpicker/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/colorpicker/qml/main.qml
@@ -26,7 +26,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     readonly property color recentColor: historyModel.hasAnyColors ? historyModel.get(0).color : "#00000000" // transparent as fallback
     readonly property string defaultFormat: Plasmoid.configuration.defaultFormat
 
-    preferredRepresentation: compactRepresentation
+    switchWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 10
+    switchHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 10
 
     toolTipMainText: "" // set to empty to prevent automatic tooltip generation through compactRepresentation
     toolTipSubText: ""
@@ -121,17 +122,55 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         id: fullRoot
 
         readonly property int columns: 3
-
-        Layout.minimumWidth: columns * Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 6
-        Layout.minimumHeight: Layout.minimumWidth
-        Layout.maximumWidth: Layout.minimumWidth
-        Layout.maximumHeight: Layout.minimumHeight
+        readonly property int rows: Math.ceil(historyModel.maxColorCount / columns)
+        readonly property real popupSize: columns * Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 6
+        // shown directly on the desktop rather than in a popup
+        readonly property bool onDesktop: parent === root
+
+        Layout.minimumWidth: onDesktop ? -1 : popupSize
+        Layout.minimumHeight: onDesktop ? -1 : popupSize
+        Layout.preferredWidth: popupSize
+        Layout.preferredHeight: popupSize
+        Layout.maximumWidth: onDesktop ? Infinity : popupSize
+        Layout.maximumHeight: onDesktop ? Infinity : popupSize
 
         cellWidth: Math.floor(fullRoot.width / fullRoot.columns)
-        cellHeight: cellWidth
+        cellHeight: onDesktop ? Math.floor((fullRoot.height - (headerItem?.height ?? 0)) / fullRoot.rows) : cellWidth
         boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
 
+        header: onDesktop ? desktopHeading : null
+
+        Component {
+            id: desktopHeading
+
+            PlasmaExtras.PlasmoidHeading {
+                width: fullRoot.width
+
+                contentItem: RowLayout {
+                    Kirigami.Heading {
+                        Layout.fillWidth: true
+                        level: 3
+                        elide: Text.ElideRight
+                        text: Plasmoid.title
+                        textFormat: Text.PlainText
+                    }
+
+                    PlasmaComponents3.ToolButton {
+                        icon.name: "color-picker"
+                        text: i18nc("@action:button", "Pick Color")
+                        display: PlasmaComponents3.AbstractButton.IconOnly
+                        onClicked: root.pickColor()
+
+                        PlasmaComponents3.ToolTip.visible: hovered || visualFocus
+                        PlasmaComponents3.ToolTip.text: text
+                        PlasmaComponents3.ToolTip.delay: Kirigami.Units.toolTipDelay
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
         model: historyModel
+        currentIndex: onDesktop ? -1 : 0
 
         highlight: PlasmaExtras.Highlight {}
         highlightMoveDuration: 0
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: Color Picker resized to 336x368 on the desktop is just a giant pick icon, the color circles run off the side
Fix: same size shows the saved colors as a grid with a Pick Color button in the heading
